title: 空力解析演習
subtitle: Aerodynamics Analysis Exercises
keywords: Numerical simulation 2.Aerodynamic analysis 3.Computational Fluid Dynamics 4.Finite volume method 5.Local collaboration
educationalGoal: With the rapid development of computers, numerical simulations for aerodynamic analysis are essential in the aircraft design process. In this practical training course, students will learn how to properly use numerical simulation for fluid dynamics in the aircraft design process. Students will also learn how to utilize numerical simulation to solve actual engineering problems that occur in their local community.
advice: In this course, students will learn numerical analysis through the use of numerical analysis software. We will cover the following materials: 1 Introduction to numerical simulation 2 Aerodynamic analysis Geometry modelling, Meshing, Computational method, Initial and boundary conditions, Execution of analysis, Evaluation of results, Comparison with experimental results
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: It is recommended that students have already taken the following courses: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 3D-CAD, Aerodynamics for Aircraft I, and Mathematical Modeling and Programming. The textbook will be handed out during the class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct basic flow field by using standard numerical analysis software
Be able to explain factors that affect analysis results
Be able to obtain information from analysis results to understand the flow field

In analysis of airfoil shapes, accurately compute the pressure distribution, lift, drag, and moment. In addition, evaluate the computational results based on knowledge of aerodynamics.
